newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 356,000 MT were 31 percent below the previous week and 48 percent under the 4-week average. Major increases for Japan (162,900 MT), Colombia (88,700 MT), the Philippines (55,000 MT), Mexico (45,000 MT), and Spain (37,100 MT) were partially offset by decreases for Lebanon (47,500 MT) and Taiwan (40,300 MT).
Net sales of 226,600 MT for delivery in 1997/98 were primarily for Malaysia (86,000 MT), unknown destinations (55,000 MT), and Japan (40,600 MT).

Exports of 662,100 MT equaled the week earlier and were 11 percent less than the 4-week average. The principal recipients were Japan (193,300 MT), Taiwan (127,600 MT), Spain (112,100 MT), and Egypt (97,800 MT).
